Messages.Author: Xian
Messages.Body:
Okay...question about conditional bleed modifiers...

For any conditional modifier to bleeds, as exemplified by Stravinsky, below:

Stravinsky
Vampire
Clan: Tzimisce
Capacity: 9
Discipline: VIC AUS ANI pot
Sabbat Archbishop of Mexico City: Stravinsky gets an additional +1 bleed
against any Methuselah who controls a younger ready Tzimisce. +1 bleed

Is the additional +1 bleed counted as "permanent," or is it applied only
during the action of bleeding? (Was that clear?)

Xian

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


It cannot be permanent - who is the Methuslelah Stravinsky is "against"
when he is not bleeding?

Stravinsky's permanent bleed level is two.
When bleeding a Meth. who controls a younger ready Tzi, his
temporary bleed level is three.
